tasks.title: Trends & policy scan (DE/EU)
tasks.description: Structural healthcare problems that will grow in the next 5–15 years, Germany/EU focus: ageing, care/nursing workforce shortage, chronic disease, hospital reform, digitization laws (DiGA, ePA, GDNG, EHDS), cost pressure. For each: sourced data, who is affected, who pays. Output: research/trends.md
tasks.notes: Draft in research/trends.md (2026-11-06). Awaiting critic review (A8). Open [UNVERIFIED] items listed in the file (PNOG cabinet version, RKI prevalence, primary Destatis releases).

tasks.title: Source map: where healthcare pain is discussed online
tasks.description: List subreddits (EN + DE), forums, review sites, professional communities, job boards, and patient groups where patients, caregivers, clinicians, nurses, pharma/CRO staff, and health admins complain. Size/activity, language, and a tested search recipe for each (Reddit blocks direct fetch from cloud servers: use web search with site:reddit.com, note when only snippets were seen). Read only, no posting. Output: research/sources-map.md

tasks.title: Pain mining: patients & caregivers
tasks.description: Using research/sources-map.md: find recurring, costly problems of patients and family caregivers (DE/EU first, global OK). Count independent signals per problem, quote short excerpts with URLs (no usernames), back the top problems with [A]/[B] data. Output: research/pain-patients.md

tasks.title: Pain mining: clinicians, nurses, practice & hospital staff
tasks.description: Same method as A3 for doctors, nurses, care staff, practice/hospital admins (e.g. documentation burden, staffing, scheduling, billing, care coordination). Output: research/pain-professionals.md

tasks.title: Pain mining: pharma, clinical research, payers, health admin
tasks.description: Same method as A3 for pharma, CROs/clinical trial staff, insurers (GKV/PKV), public health, medtech. Output: research/pain-industry.md

tasks.title: Munich ecosystem: grants, capital, co-founders
tasks.description: Funding programs (e.g. EXIST, Bavarian state programs, EU EIC/Horizon health calls) with eligibility, amounts, deadlines, and whether a part-time founder qualifies; Munich accelerators/incubators with health focus; active health/digital-health investors (pre-seed/seed) in Munich/DACH; where to find co-founders (CTO, clinical). Output: research/munich-ecosystem.md

tasks.title: Reimbursement & funding routes for digital health products in DE (status late 2026)
tasks.description: Current status and conditions of each route a small health-tech startup could sell through: DiGA (after FinanzKommission/BStabG/GeDIG changes), DiPA, §64e/Selektivverträge, PNOG digital fund for outpatient care (cabinet/Bundestag version, Förderrichtlinie timing), hospital transformation fund eligibility for software, KHZG follow-up. Per route: who decides, amounts, timing, evidence required. Primary sources (BMG, BfArM, GKV-SV, Bundestag Drucksachen). Output: research/reimbursement-routes.md
tasks.reason: A1 found payers in cost-cutting mode, DiGA rules tightening, and new public digitisation funds (PNOG €1.6bn, transformation fund); B1 criterion 3 (willingness/ability to pay) needs a verified map of these routes.

tasks.title: Long list of 20–30 problems
tasks.description: Merge A1–A5 and archive/cancer-problem-statement.md into 20–30 distinct problems. Per problem: one-line statement, who has it, who pays, evidence count and grades, links to supporting research. Output: research/longlist.md

tasks.title: Critic review of Stage A
tasks.description: Review each Stage A research file as it appears (sources, grades, cherry-picking, [C]-only claims). Mark done when every A file has a current review. Output: research/reviews/

tasks.title: Score long list, pick top 5
tasks.description: Score every long-list problem with research/scoring.md (table + evidence links), rank, write the top 5 with reasoning and a one-paragraph venture sketch each. Then add a ceo task: 'Pick 2–3 ideas for deep dive' with options and a recommendation. Output: research/shortlist.md

tasks.title: Critic review of shortlist
tasks.description: Stress-test scoring and the top 5: inflated scores, weak evidence, missed killers. Output: research/reviews/

tasks.title: Venture briefs for the CEO's picks
tasks.description: One venture brief per idea the CEO picked, using templates/venture-brief.md, in ventures/<slug>/brief.md. Split into one task per idea when unblocked.
tasks.blocked_by: CEO decision: pick 2–3 ideas from research/shortlist.md
